jana: FYI - a few new users hit the sampleapp and see fragments arriving out of order plus a stray '\n' parse error when our edge proxy retries during token rotation. repro on web + ios.
pete: can you paste a short log?
jana: minimal repro: start stream, force token rotate at ~50s. sometimes the proxy retries a half-flushed connection and the client sees:
[2026-04-02T10:12:00Z] sse: connected
[2026-04-02T10:12:50Z] auth: rotate start
[2026-04-02T10:12:50Z] sse: recv part seq=312 data="The quick "
[2026-04-02T10:12:50Z] proxy: retry upstream (id=xy)
[2026-04-02T10:12:50Z] sse: recv part seq=313 data="brown fox"
[2026-04-02T10:12:50Z] client: parse error: unexpected "\\n"
[2026-04-02T10:12:50Z] client: reconnect last_event_id=313
[2026-04-02T10:12:50Z] sse: recv part seq=313 data="brown fox" // duplicate
[2026-04-02T10:12:50Z] sse: recv part seq=314 data=" jumps" // arrives after duplicate -> UI shows fragments scrambled

hao: sounds like three separate things: (1) proxy retry can split a single event across two upstreams, (2) client parser emits per-line so fragmentation can reorder, (3) abort-vs-wait behavior on refresh triggers duplicate final parts.
pete: agree. short fixlist: (A) normalize SSE parsing across SDKs to emit only on complete event delimiter (header+blank line), (B) add lightweight dedupe keyed by event id/seq for a 2s window, fallback to checksum, (C) make proxy retry attach resume hint so it doesn't replay last chunk, (D) sampleapp: avoid xhr.abort() during rotate for onboarding builds.
jana: can we also add a small UI mitigation: coalesce adjacent fragments with identical seq checksums for 1s when rendering to avoid visible scrambles?
hao: good idea. i'll open INF ticket for proxy behavior (INF-4477) to make retry cooperate with SSE resume semantics.
ci-bot: CI job queued: sse-fragment-parity-tests.
support-bot: created KB entry kb/sse-proxy-retry-fragments with recommended troubleshooting.
pete: i'll submit small PRs: js parser change + client dedupe, sampleapp abort removal, and a unit test that forces proxy retry mid-event. jana: i'll add the UI coalesce and a short onboarding blurb for streaming: "Streams may briefly reconnect during token rotation; the app will resume and de-duplicate content."
jana: closing for now; will monitor INF + CI and reopen if staging telemetry on sse.resume.duplicate stays high. :white_check_mark:
